description: Create and manage Technical Debt Records (TDRs) — the only writer of tdr/: create, update a status, list, audit ("check TDRs") and compact TDRs. Use whenever the user mentions deferred work, known compromises, shortcuts taken, "we'll fix this later", temporary workarounds, missing controls, or an architectural trade-off that should be visible and tracked; when the architecture's technical-debt section (Section 13, or Section 11 in legacy layouts) is written or updated; or when an ADR accepts debt on purpose. Not for bug reports, feature requests or backlog items — TDRs record architectural or systemic compromises, not ordinary defects.
